s3_origin.bucket_policy_intent: Allow s3:GetObject only to the specified CloudFront distribution using the CloudFront service principal and SourceArn condition
s3_origin.note: Reference only; this policy is not applied.

lambda_at_edge.note: Associate only the event(s) needed. No Lambda function is deployed.

private_assets.note: CloudFront native signed URL/key-group flow is not implemented by the local HMAC simulation.

image_optimization.note: The WebP object must exist in S3. No on-demand image conversion is run at the edge.
